title: Eleven Minutes
subtitle: 改变成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 改变成长（做人与做事·改变与成长）
meta: 主题语境：改变成长（做人与做事·改变与成长）　|　核心词汇：reason　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reason 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① reason I stopped running away from difficult things was not courage. It was a bus timetable. When my family moved across the city I had to change buses twice and walk eleven minutes, and for the first month I was late nearly every day.

My form teacher asked me once, kindly, why. I ② reasoned that the second bus always arrived late, which was true but useless. There was no ③ reason to assume the timetable cared about me, she said, and she suggested leaving eleven minutes earlier. It had honestly never occurred to me that anything about this could be changed. ④ For this reason alone I count that conversation as the beginning of everything.

Change, I discovered, has very little to do with feelings and much more to do with arithmetic: eleven minutes, twice a day. Anything ⑤ within reason is easy once it becomes a habit, and anything outside habit is hard even when it is small. There is every reason to believe that small adjustments add up.

In the spring my younger brother refused to go to school at all. My mother tried to ⑥ reason with him for two hours and achieved nothing. I said nothing, took him to the bus station at seven in the morning and simply showed him the timetable. He went back the following Monday. They say you cannot ⑦ reason somebody out of fear, and they are mostly right: what removes fear is not argument but evidence.

Fear itself is often beyond ⑧ reason, which is precisely the trouble with it; you cannot argue a child into a classroom. But most of what we call personality is just a set of habits nobody has ever examined. The ⑨ reason so few people change is not laziness: it is that nobody has ever shown them the arithmetic. Every change has its reason, though it is rarely the one we give. Nothing about me altered except eleven minutes, and within a year I was more or less a different person. ⑩ For that reason I tell anybody who will listen — find the arithmetic first, then argue with yourself about the courage.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 理智；理性（beyond reason 不合常理）
C. n. 道理；根据（there is no reason to do）
D. v. 推断；推论（reason that ...）
E. 固定搭配：for this/that reason 因为这个缘故
F. 固定搭配：reason sb out of sth 说服某人放弃／摆脱
G. 固定搭配：within reason 在合理范围内
H. 固定搭配：reason with sb 与某人讲道理

items.q: The reason I stopped running away
I reasoned that the second bus always arrived late
There was no reason to assume
For this reason alone I count that conversation
My mother tried to reason with him
you cannot reason somebody out of fear
Fear itself is often beyond reason
The reason so few people change
For that reason I tell anybody

answers.why: the reason＋定语从句，意为“……的原因”，说明作者不再逃避的原因。
reason＋that 从句，是动词“推断、推论”，作者据此为自己迟到辩解。
there is no reason to do 意为“没有理由／根据去做”，老师提醒他别指望时刻表迁就自己。
for this reason 意为“因此”，引出作者把那次谈话视为转折点的缘由。
within reason 意为“在合理范围内”，说明只要适度，事情养成习惯后就容易。
reason with sb 意为“与某人讲道理”，母亲劝了弟弟两个小时却毫无结果。
reason sb out of＋心理状态，意为“用道理说服某人摆脱”，这里指难用道理消除恐惧。
beyond reason 意为“超出常理、无法理喻”，说明恐惧常常不受理性支配。
同样是“……的原因”，指很少有人改变的根本原因。
与第 4 题同为 for that reason，意为“正因为如此”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我不再逃避困难的原因并不是勇气。（reason n.）
我当时推断第二班车总是晚点。（reason v.）
没有理由认为时刻表会迁就任何人。（there is no reason to）
正因为这一点，我把那次谈话看作一切的开始。（for this reason）
只要合乎常理的事，一旦成为习惯都不难做到。（within reason）
母亲试着和我弟弟讲道理，讲了整整两个小时。（reason with）
answers: The reason I stopped running away was not courage.
I reasoned that the second bus always arrived late.
There is no reason to assume the timetable cares about anybody.
For this reason alone I count that conversation as the beginning of everything.
Anything within reason is easy once it becomes a habit.
My mother tried to reason with my brother for two whole hours.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reason 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The reason I stopped running away from difficulties was not courage but a bus timetable.
I reasoned that the second bus was always late, though there was no reason to assume the timetable cared about me.
For this reason my teacher's advice — leave eleven minutes earlier — became the beginning of everything.
Anything within reason grows easy once it becomes a habit, and that is why every little adjustment counts.
My mother tried to reason with my brother for two hours, but you cannot reason somebody out of fear.
Fear is often beyond reason; for that reason I tell people to find the arithmetic first and argue about courage later.
